name: Yoshiba Kyoko
source:
An orc of unknown gender that acts boyish.
They have a love relationship with their classmate Yumeno Kanami. Feelings are rich, personality is fragile, easy to shed tears.
Has been striving to become Yumeno Kanami's confidant.
